queryTaskStatusOutput.note: Index is from this pinned ABI, not the SDK TypeScript interface member ordering. Do not log/store the full queryTask response or taskResults.

limitations: This registry is a discovery seed from official source, not runtime or deployment approval.
No live RPC, explorer, bytecode, proxy implementation, deployment block, finality, event activity, fee semantics or historical compatibility has been verified.
The Base address is a zkTLS network task contract, not a confidential-finance vault or FHE contract.
SubmitTask creates one task with potentially multiple attestors. ReportResult is per-attestor and has no task-success field.
CallbackFailed is callback execution failure, not proof or task failure. WithdrawBalance can settle multiple task IDs.
Native task status and cryptographic proof validity are different. Status interpretation requires runtime-supported ABI and validated semantics.

QueryTask ABI necessarily describes attestation output fields; this fixture includes schema only, no live taskResults or confidential example arguments. Discovery output must allowlist safe metadata and exclude request/header/body/data/attConditions/additionParams/templateId/callback reason and full taskResults.
Non-indexed dynamic fields must not be treated as safe analytics payloads merely because they are on-chain.
Selected ABI excludes every value-moving function. No transaction generation or signing is provided.
